review_notes: Read the whole file and grepped repo uses of isMaximalTorus_iff and image_lieExp_lieSubalgebraOfSubgroup. The only use of the Lie-group isMaximalTorus_iff is its declaration (the `rw [isMaximalTorus_iff]` hits in Algebraic/Torus/Maximal.lean refer to a different, namespaced lemma). The simp attribute on `IsTorus.image_lieExp_lieSubalgebraOfSubgroup` looked acceptable. Its hypothesis `IsTorus T` is a side condition that simp may not be able to discharge, but that is only a mild concern. I did not examine simp behaviour on `IsMaximalTorus` in downstream files beyond grep, so the finding rests on reading the definitions, not on running Lean.

findings.excerpt:
@[simp]
theorem isMaximalTorus_iff {T : Subgroup G} : IsMaximalTorus T ↔ Maximal IsTorus T :=
  Iff.rfl
findings.problem: `IsMaximalTorus` is a named definition with its own API (`IsMaximalTorus.isTorus`, `IsMaximalTorus.eq_of_le`, and the main theorems). The `@[simp]` attribute makes simp unfold every `IsMaximalTorus T` into the generic `Maximal IsTorus T`. After that rewrite, the dot-notation lemmas no longer match syntactically. The goal also switches from the project's vocabulary to Mathlib's `Maximal`. This is an unwanted expansion of a definition. The lemma is an `Iff.rfl` unfolding lemma, so it is not a useful normal-form rule. The only non-trivial use of `IsMaximalTorus` in this file, `isMaximalTorus_top`, is proved by an anonymous constructor, so nothing depends on simp unfolding it. No other file in the repo uses this lemma. The same-named lemma in the algebraic-group torus file is a separate declaration in a different namespace.
findings.proposed_change: Remove `@[simp]` from `isMaximalTorus_iff`, keeping it as an ordinary unfolding lemma for explicit `rw`. If unfolding is wanted for some goals, use `simp [IsMaximalTorus]` or `rw [isMaximalTorus_iff]` locally. Alternatively, make `IsMaximalTorus` an `abbrev`, or drop the lemma and rely on the `Maximal`-based `IsMaximalTorus.isTorus` and `IsMaximalTorus.eq_of_le`.
findings.benefit: Simp calls on goals or hypotheses mentioning `IsMaximalTorus T` keep the named predicate, so its API lemmas still apply. Users no longer see the expansion into `Maximal IsTorus T`.

theorem IsMaximalTorus.eq_of_le {T T' : Subgroup G} (hT : IsMaximalTorus T)
